about: Source of truth for the Bitcoin Fee Index pages (built by Kimi_Agent_Virtuse%20MiCA%20Partners/i18n-tools/fee-index/build_fee_index.py). fee_pct must equal 100 x pct in fee-schedule-live.json (the builder checks). Spreads: measure_spreads.py --write for the exchanges; 21bitcoin from its app price vs Kraken mid at the same minute.

rows.name: 21bitcoin
rows.fee_fact: Auto-Invest savings plan: 0% service fee from day 8; the first 7 days carry the regular 0.99% (0.79% with a referral code). Instant buy (Smash Buy) 1.49%.

rows.name: Bybit EU
rows.fee_fact: Spot trading fee 0.25% at VIP 0, maker and taker alike (bybit.eu fee page, new fee structure for trades from 5 Oct 2026; page last updated 5 Oct 2026, checked on bybit.eu 12 Oct 2026, 14:16 UTC).

rows.name: Kraken Pro
rows.fee_fact: Kraken Pro spot, Tier 1 ($0+ 30-day volume): 0.40% maker, 0.80% taker. Instant Buy in the Kraken app is a separate route: a 1% fee plus a spread.

spread_21bitcoin.method: We compare the buy price the 21bitcoin app shows before confirming with the Kraken BTC/EUR mid price (1-minute OHLC close) at the same minute.

spreads.method: market buy against the public BTC/EUR order book, average fill vs mid price
